coachMemory.title: What your coach remembers
coachMemory.hint: The coach can remember useful things you tell it across conversations: goals, preferences and constraints. Review them here, or tell the coach when something changes.
coachMemory.deleteHint: This removes the saved memory. Your chat messages, profile and measurements are kept separately.
coachMemory.error: Couldn't load the coach's memory. Try again.
coachMemory.deleteError: Couldn't remove the memory. Reload and try again.
coachMemory.unavailable: Your reply is ready, but memory couldn't be updated. Tell the coach again later if you want this remembered.
coachMemory.conflict: Memory changed during this reply. Review the latest memories before adding it again.
coachMemory.full: Your coach's saved memory is full. Forget an old item, then tell the coach what to remember again.
coachMemory.progressHint: A factual overview of your full saved history, using daily medians and keeping different sources and methods separate. Your coach uses it for context; it is not a diagnosis.
coachMemory.progressEmpty: Save a measurement to start your progress overview.
coachMemory.progressError: Couldn't load your progress overview. Try again.
coachMemory.personalOnly: Personal memories are separate from your measurement history.
